permissionAndConcurrencyChecks: Student MOBILE-only read routes; publishing and generic web endpoints stay denied; strict query, scope and identifier bounds
Only current institution and authorized published/archived courses; membership withdrawal, unpublished courses, missing/deleted or foreign announcements reject access

Announcement reads acquire a scoped transaction lock then resolve the current session, account/role, learning and course permission; actual queued enrollment/account/session revocations prevent new content reads
Lists support organization/course filters, course-specific scope and literal case-insensitive title search including SQL wildcard characters, with stable date/id pagination
Actual web publishing enqueues notifications; an isolated real Nest application context runs the existing worker and creates actual per-user notification records
Notification target requires an owned record, a strict announcement event identity, matching internal link and current accessible announcement; opening never marks read
Explicit capability query opts new clients into announcement targets; old clients retain their previous course targets and global canOpen flags
Native Android verifies institution body, course entry/title search, paging/restart, content hidden after membership withdrawal or deletion, exact notification navigation and unchanged unread state

resolvedDuringAcceptance: Compatibility review found that adding a new typed target without negotiation would make older App versions reject an announcement notification that previously opened a course. Added explicit opt-in to list/target queries and real old-client regression assertions. Superseded full/device runs were intentionally stopped (the owned preview app was stopped, causing the disposable device run to fail and clean up). Both APKs were rebuilt and final full/native gates rerun against the frozen final sources; no original services were stopped.

Initial dedicated tests incorrectly assumed synchronous notification creation and expected403 from unregistered write routes. Validation now runs the actual existing background worker against the guarded disposable fixture and asserts404 for absent native write endpoints, while unit and live generic-web route assertions separately verify mobile capability denial. All22 new and existing inbox checks pass.
limits: This round adds read-only teaching announcements; mobile publishing, editing, replies, attachments, system push and persistent offline announcements are not included
Native text/formatting does not execute HTML or fetch external images; external link interaction remains on the website
Automatic refresh is30 seconds and foreground-triggered; content already delivered cannot be remotely erased, but a failed current detail refresh hides its body
Announcement feature policy matches the website: disabling discussion/practice does not disable teaching announcements
Server must update new mobile announcement endpoints and notification capability handling; no new schema migration, previous required migrations still apply
Local and production data/accounts remain independent; full Android acceptance uses Android12 arm64 emulator, synthetic cameras and host microphone disabled
Physical devices, Bluetooth, cellular, weak network and TURN still require hardware checks; iOS/store release not performed
Public Android debug signing is preview-only; HTTPS preview forbids cleartext and both APKs are bundled, non-debuggable with backups disabled
Inherited build advisories remain visible with fingerprinted backports; raw audit is not zero, no unmitigated advisory accepted
privacy: Disposable local fixtures only; no paid AI/Judge calls, production changes, credentials, environment files, private config or databases included
